Yang

messages.author: 5fa2a363d4ddd1d1
messages.subject: Re: Question about fitting model in NIMBLE
parts:
hi Yang,

As long as you can write the model in the NIMBLE model language (essentially the BUGS language), this should be possible. If you use MCMC for fitting, mixing may vary widely with the parameterization used and the MCMC configuration details. And the speed of fitting may be affected by exactly how any linear algebra computations are written.

Others may have more specific suggestions...

-chris
